title: engine conformance vector
description: One given state, one operation and one expected outcome, in no implementation's language.

id.description: The vector's identity, naming its own family first so a report groups itself.

op.description: The operation a driver performs for this vector.

covers.description: The section of the unified plugin system design this vector witnesses.

given.description: The state the driver sets up. Each op owns its own shape.

then.description: What the outcome must show. An absent key asserts nothing.
